rule_definition: Not null and unique in current customer snapshot
failure_handling: Block downstream publication; log data-quality incident

rule_definition: Every active account links to a valid customer key
failure_handling: Quarantine unresolved rows and investigate referential integrity

rule_definition: Date is valid and not in the future
failure_handling: Reject invalid event; retain source trace

rule_definition: Value belongs to the steward-approved code set
failure_handling: Map only via approved rule; never silently coerce unknown values

rule_definition: Feature timestamp is at or before scoring timestamp
failure_handling: Fail scoring batch; use approved fallback queue

rule_definition: All included records fall inside declared reporting window
failure_handling: Block board MI refresh; publish known limitation

rule_definition: Use is approved for this purpose and aggregation; field-level access is restricted
failure_handling: Stop use pending privacy and purpose review

rule_definition: Every scored decision references a registered model version
failure_handling: Hold release and reconcile registry to scoring logs
